author: Priyanka Patel
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds4 & Buds4 Pro: Price Leak Revealed
text:
Samsung’s next generation of wireless earbuds, the Galaxy Buds4 and Galaxy Buds4 Pro, are expected to debut alongside the Galaxy S26 series on February 25. Pricing details, originating from France, suggest the Buds4 will cost €179, while the Buds4 Pro will be priced at €249.
New Earbuds, Familiar Prices
Samsung is poised to expand its audio lineup with the Buds4 and Buds4 Pro, offering a potential upgrade for users seeking immersive sound.
Both the Galaxy Buds4 and Buds4 Pro will initially be available in classic black and white color options. However, a third “Apricot” colorway may be exclusive to Samsung’s online store for the Pro model, adding a touch of personality to the premium earbuds.
Interestingly, the leaked prices mirror those of the Galaxy Buds3 and Galaxy Buds3 Pro at their launch in France. This price consistency is a welcome sign, especially considering current global inflation.
The timing of the earbuds’ release alongside the Galaxy S26 series suggests Samsung is aiming for a comprehensive product launch, catering to both smartphone and audio enthusiasts.
- The Galaxy Buds4 are rumored to cost €179.
- The Galaxy Buds4 Pro are rumored to cost €249.
- Both models will be available in black and white.
- An “Apricot” color may be exclusive to Samsung’s online store for the Pro model.
- A free 25W wireless charging pad will be offered with early purchases in France.
